name: Ground-Based Plasma-F
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 14. One of the ground base fits — the chassis is the
GBD1's and is identical across all of them: one shield of 12 (P2.73), two hull boxes, a bridge,
sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0, five crew, two boarding parties, minCrew 2, DK:4, EX:0,
CR:0. Only the weapons, the power plant, the BPV and the year differ.
NOT MODELLED: the Gorn carronade refit (Y165, +0) — 'plasma carronades cannot be used
prior to Y165; from Y165 they are available to the Gorns at no increase in BPV cost' —
and the Sabot refit (Y180, +2). Both need rules from Module R10.
